verdict.rationale: Honeybadger does connect to GitHub/GitLab: a deploy revision links to a diff of what changed since the last deploy, and deploy tracking helps correlate code changes with errors. That is only a loose, deploy-level stand-in for suspect commits. Missing for 10: per-issue suspect-commit attribution, code-owner assignment, jumping from a stack frame to the source line on the default branch, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
